narrative.overview: The incumbent portfolio combines a dark navy canvas, blue light, pixel display lettering, and terminal-like navigation. The blog extends that identity into a quieter reading surface: the same canvas and type families, stronger text contrast, and simple ruled article rows. These notes describe the shipped HTML and CSS, not a proposed redesign.
keyCharacteristics: Pixel headings establish identity; sans-serif text carries extended reading.
Monospaced navigation, metadata, and topic controls connect the blog to the portfolio.
Blue identifies links and interaction; thin borders organize content.

rules.name: The Reading Type Rule
rules.body: Preserve sans-serif article titles and body text; retain pixel lettering for the identity and library heading.

dos: **Do** extend the existing navy, blue, and terminal vocabulary using the current HTML/CSS conventions.
**Do** keep Vietnamese diacritics legible and verify single-column reading at narrow widths.
**Do** retain semantic links, labels, keyboard focus, and native disclosure controls.
donts: **Don't** apply the portfolio's decorative overlays to the blog reading surface without checking legibility.
**Don't** imply the Vietnamese blog has translated editions because the portfolio has language controls.
